s: At the Spring Festival, we enjoy ___ together.（选择正确形式）
o: to making dumplings|make dumplings|making dumplings|makes dumplings
e: enjoy 后面接动名词，用 making；to making 把 to 和 ing 混在一起，make 是原形，makes 是第三人称单数，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

s: 把 “I like to eat mooncakes.” 改成用 enjoy 说，意思不变，哪一句正确（  ）
o: I enjoy to eat mooncakes.|I enjoy eat mooncakes.|I enjoy eats mooncakes.|I enjoy eating mooncakes.
e: like to eat 和 enjoy eating 意思相同；enjoy 后面要接动名词 eating，to eat、eat、eats 都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

s: — Do you enjoy watching the moon? — No, ___（选择正确答句）
e: Do you enjoy ...? 的否定回答用 No, I don't.；I'm not 对应 Are you ...?，I can't 对应 Can you ...?，I didn't 对应 Did you ...?。

s: 春节时，孩子们喜欢一起做灯笼。下面哪一句最自然（  ）
o: Children enjoy to make lanterns together.|Children enjoy make lanterns together.|Children enjoy makes lanterns together.|Children enjoy making lanterns together.
e: enjoy 后面接动名词 making；to make 是不定式，make 是原形，makes 是第三人称单数，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

s: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 后面直接接了名词（  ）
o: We enjoy watching the moon at night.|We enjoy eating mooncakes together.|We enjoy the moon at the festival.|We enjoy making lanterns together.
e: the moon 是名词，直接作 enjoy 的宾语；另外三句 enjoy 后面都是动名词短语 watching、eating、making。

s: — What do you enjoy doing at the festival? — ___（选择正确答句）
o: I enjoy to get together with my family.|I enjoy getting together with family.|I enjoy get together with my family.|I enjoy gets together with my family.
e: 问句问 enjoy doing，回答也用 enjoy doing：getting together 是动名词；to get 是不定式，get 是原形，gets 是第三人称单数，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

s: 下面哪一句的意思与其他三句相反（  ）
o: I love eating mooncakes very much.|I don't like eating mooncakes.|I like eating mooncakes very much.|I enjoy eating mooncakes very much.
e: don't like 是不喜欢；love、like、enjoy 都表示喜欢，所以这一句意思相反。

s: 下面哪一句中 like 后面的形式不对（  ）
o: My sister likes draw lanterns.|My sister likes drawing lanterns.|My sister likes making dumplings.|My sister likes singing songs.
e: like 后面接动名词，likes drawing、likes making、likes singing 都对；likes draw 少了 ing，这一句不对。

s: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 和 like 都用对了（  ）
o: I enjoy to read stories and I like drawing pictures.|I enjoy reading stories and I like to drawing pictures.|I enjoy reading stories and I like drawing pictures.|I enjoy read stories and I like draw pictures.
e: enjoy 和 like 后面都接动名词，reading 和 drawing 都对；to read 是不定式，to drawing 混了结构，read 和 draw 是原形。

s: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 后面的词需要改成 ing 形式（  ）
o: We enjoy play games at the festival.|We enjoy playing games at the festival.|We enjoy making lanterns at the festival.|We enjoy eating mooncakes at the festival.
e: enjoy 后面要接动名词，play 要改成 playing；其余三句已经用了 playing、making、eating，形式都对。

s: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 后面接名词和接动名词都用对了（  ）
o: We enjoy the lanterns and we enjoy to make dumplings.|We enjoy the lanterns and we enjoy making dumplings.|We enjoy to see the lanterns and we enjoy making dumplings.|We enjoy see the lanterns and we enjoy make dumplings.
e: the lanterns 是名词，可以直接作 enjoy 的宾语；making 是动名词。to make 是不定式，see 和 make 是原形，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

s: 读句子：“My sister enjoys to sing and she loves dancing.” 下面哪一种改法把句子改对了（  ）
o: My sister enjoys to singing and she loves dancing.|My sister enjoy singing and she loves dancing.|My sister enjoys sing and she loves dancing.|My sister enjoys singing and she loves dancing.
e: enjoy 后面接动名词，to sing 要改成 singing；to singing 混了结构，enjoy 少了 s 与主语不一致，enjoys sing 少了 ing。后半句 loves dancing 是对的。
